title: Siege of Hamburg
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Siege of Hamburg", at revision 1371009014, opens: "The siege of Hamburg took place from December 1813 to May 1814, at the end of the wars of the War of the Sixth Coalition. The French garrison of Hamburg, commanded by Marshal Davout, resisted the coalition forces of Prussia, the Russian Empire, and Sweden for nearly six months." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q7510071, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1813–1814 siege during the War of the Sixth Coalition". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
